reading.body:
SlidesAI is a presentation generation tool founded in 2023 in Sharjah, UAE, that converts notes, documents, PDFs, and prompts into slides compatible with Google Slides, PowerPoint, and ChatGPT.

SlidesAI targets a broad audience across education and professional work. Teachers use it to build lecture materials, students to convert research into thesis presentations, and professionals to produce polished decks quickly. The company positions itself in direct competition with Gamma, Canva, Plus AI, and Presentations.ai, all operating in the same narrow category of AI-assisted slide generation. Entry-level pricing is available on month-to-month billing, keeping switching costs low for individual users.

This product category represents a thin slice of the AI economy: presentation generation consumes modest compute, operates on commodity infrastructure, and requires no specialized power or building investment. It sits far downstream from the binding constraints that shape AI scaling. The data here shows no patent filings, litigation, or significant corporate structure, which is consistent with a small, user-facing consumer tool rather than an infrastructure play.

The record captures only what the company claims on its own website and notes when information is missing. It does not include user adoption, revenue, or whether the tool actually performs better than competitors in the category. It offers no view into whether this category will persist or be subsumed into larger suites.

profile_text.body:
SlidesAI is a presentation-generation tool that turns notes, documents, PDFs and prompts into slide decks. According to its site, it works inside Google Slides, PowerPoint, ChatGPT and the web, and is aimed at teachers building lecture slides, students turning research notes into presentations, and professionals who need decks quickly. The company was founded in 2023 and is headquartered in Sharjah, AE.

The site presents a feature comparison of SlidesAI against Gamma, Canva, Plus AI and Presentations.ai, marking each capability as fully supported, partially supported or not supported. It states that the comparison was verified against each vendor's public documentation on 23 July 2026, that prices cited are entry-level paid individual plans on month-to-month billing in US dollars, and that Presentations.ai sells its Pro plan annually only at $240/year, so its monthly figure is an annual equivalent. The site also notes that prices vary by country and that features and pricing change often.

No lawsuits, MCP servers or other filings are recorded for the company.
